pages.text: To master the skies, an aviator must always know which way the air flows. The $(2)Wind Vane$() is an essential handheld engineering tool designed to read current atmospheric conditions and wind currents.
Here is the standard crafting recipe for the Wind Vane, utilizing basic metals, copper, and structural components.

pages.title: Using the Vane
pages.text: Right-click the air with the Wind Vane in hand to instantly measure the weather intensity and direction. It will report whether there is a soft breeze, strong wind, or hurricane, allowing you to plan heavy shipments.

pages.title: Reading the Wind
pages.text: When used successfully, a chat notification will appear showing the precise direction and speed of the wind currents around you.

pages.title: Wind Sensor
pages.text: For advanced meteorologists, the $(2)Wind Sensor$() automates weather reading. Bind it to a target Dock using the Controller, then place it in the world.

pages.title: Redstone Output
pages.text: Once placed, the Wind Sensor actively monitors the wind blowing towards its linked destination. It outputs a $(4)Redstone Signal$(). Perfect for creating automated smart-launch systems that only dispatch cargo during tailwinds!
